topic: Syncing frequency model from stage to production
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on synchronizing data and models between the staging (stage) and production (prod) environments. Initially, [me] restored the stage environment from a model to ensure data integrity.

Later, it was determined that the same frequency formula used for 'Viva' must be applied consistently across both stage and production environments. A key decision was made to apply the frequency model currently active on staging to production, ensuring consistency after a demonstration/demo period.
decisions: Apply the frequency model from the staging environment to the production environment.
action_items: Ensure the correct frequency formula is applied consistently across stage and production environments.
